text: Name something you'd pack for a trip down the Great Ocean Road.

answers.note: Zinc is its own entry; collapse brands (Banana Boat, Cancer Council) here.
Victorian word is bathers; accept any swimwear term including boardies and bikini.
Footwear, not underwear. Slides and sandals collapse here; Crocs and Blundstones are separate.
Changing poncho / hooded towel is a separate deep entry.
Beanie is separate (warm hat).
Any pullover-style warm top. Jacket/puffer and raincoat are separate.
Four seasons in one day down there. Driza-bone is a separate deep entry.
Non-waterproof outer layer; raincoat is separate.
Flannelette shirt. Any spelling of flanno/flannie.
Comfy pants of any sort, leggings and activewear included.
Any top that is not a jumper/jacket. Singlet is separate.
'Socks and jocks' as a combined answer lands here; plain 'socks' is its own entry.
Generic 'clothes' or 'layers' is correct but scores as a group; push for a specific item if the room wants rarity.
Any ordinary closed shoe; hiking boots, gumboots, Blundstones, Crocs are separate.
Otways walks, Great Ocean Walk. Blundstones and gumboots have their own entries.
Victorian-coded footwear; RM Williams and Rossis collapse here as elastic-sided boots.
Genuine deep cut: rock-pooling at Point Roadknight / Lorne or a cold-water surf.
The thick stick/cream kind. Ordinary sunscreen is a separate common entry.
Bells, Winki, Lorne Point, Johanna. Wetsuit, wax and leg rope are separate entries.
Southern Ocean is cold year-round. Steamer/springsuit/wettie all collapse here.
Skimboard collapses here (still a beach board).
Surfer's deep cut; surfboard fins and fin key collapse here.
Goggles and flippers both collapse here; surfboard fins belong with Leg Rope.
Rain umbrella collapses here too; windscreen sunshade for the car is separate.
Canvas windbreak with poles. Correct and genuinely deep: GOR beaches are famously windy.
Beach chair and camp chair are the same answer here.
Bedding blankets and doonas are a separate entry.
Kids' sandcastle gear. Camping shovel/trowel is separate.
Any ball for a kick on the sand. Beach ball (inflatable) is separate.
Catch-all for outdoor/lawn games (Finska, bocce, spikeball). Board games and cards are separate.
Any water inflatable or flotation aid, lifejacket included.
Anglesea River, Aire River, Lake Elizabeth. SUP and canoe collapse here.
Fishing licence is a separate deep entry; crab/yabby nets are separate.
Forrest MTB trails. Bike rack, helmets and scooters collapse here.
Torquay and Apollo Bay skate parks.
Powered car fridge (Engel/Waeco) is a separate rare entry.
Powered fridge, not an esky.
Any beer brand or quantity word (slab, carton, stubbies, tinnies, coldies). Local GOR breweries (Blackman's, Prickly Moses, Sow & Piglets, Rogue Wave, Forrest) count as beer.
Bottled wine of any style. Goon / cask wine is its own entry.
Cask wine, distinct from bottled wine. Goon of Fortune counts.
Generic alcohol or any spirit / premix. Beer, wine, goon and cider are separate; if they say both, use the specific one.
Generic. Chips, lollies, chocolate, Tim Tams, biscuits, trail mix and fruit are separate specific entries; accept both.
Any packet chip or extruded snack (Twisties, Cheezels, Burger Rings, Doritos) collapses here.
Any confectionery or gum. Chocolate is its own entry; Maltesers/M&Ms go to whichever entry the first player used.
Any chocolate bar or block; liquorice lumped here.
Specific enough to keep separate from generic biscuits.
Any biscuit, cracker, slice or home-baking. Tim Tams kept separate; Jatz/water crackers sit with Cheese Platter.
Healthy-ish car snacks: nuts, muesli bars, dried fruit, bliss balls, Roll-Ups, Up & Go.
Any fresh fruit or vegetable, including salad makings.
Any breakfast/sandwich spread (Vegemite, Nutella, peanut butter, jam, honey, butter).
Any pre-made lunch, roll, wrap or pre-cooked meal (bolognese, lasagne, leftovers, pies, sausage rolls).
Any cheese, dip, cracker or charcuterie item. Chips are separate.

Catch-all for BBQ meat and any 'food / groceries / dinner ingredients' answer. Snags is the canonical because it is the single most common specific. Bacon and eggs, bread, sauce, fruit, spreads, sandwiches and platters are separate.
Any bread product.
Any sauce or condiment.
Catch-all for breakfast food: bacon, eggs, cereal, milk, juice, yoghurt, pancakes. Coffee, tea and Milo are separate.
Campfire treats: marshmallows, s'mores kit, damper mix and jaffle iron all land here.
Any drinking water, drink bottle brand, cordial, sports drink or kombucha. Soft drink is separate; the 20L camping water container is separate.
Any soft drink or energy drink. Juice and cordial sit with Bacon and Eggs / Water Bottle; ice cream and icy poles are a separate rare entry.
Only works with a car freezer or holiday-house freezer, but a real answer Victorians give.
Any coffee, coffee gear, iced coffee or flavoured milk. Thermos, tea and Milo are separate.
Tea in any form. Coffee and Milo/hot chocolate are separate.
Milo and any hot chocolate / malted drink collapse here.
Vacuum flask of any brand or size; the urn is lumped in.
Reusable coffee cup or any mug. Plates/cutlery and plastic party cups are a separate entry.
Power bank collapses here.
Any music answer. Podcasts are separate; speaker is separate.

Fuel, fuel money, jerry cans and EV charging all collapse here. Camping gas bottle is separate.
Money in any form; 'coins for the showers' is a real caravan-park answer.
ID in any form; rego lumped here.

Roadside assist membership of any flavour; insurance papers lumped in. Genuinely deep, definitely correct.

answers.note: The dog and all its kit. Plenty of dog-friendly beaches (Anglesea, Lorne off-leash areas).

aliases: something to do in the car
answers.note: The kids, the family, and anything 'for the kids / for the car' that is not a specific object. Toys, colouring books and iPad are separate entries.
People who are not the kids/dog: partner, friends, a designated driver. Grade generously but it is one answer however it is phrased.
Everything for a baby or toddler: nappies, pram, portacot, car seat, formula, kids' Panadol.
The vehicle itself, hire vans, 4WDs and motorbikes with riding gear. Treat as one answer; people do say 'a reliable car'.
Swag and gazebo are separate; tent pegs/mallet are a separate deep entry.
Anything you sleep on at camp, pump included.

Fairy/festoon lights and any campsite decoration (bunting, flags, balloons).
Firewood, kindling, heat beads and charcoal. Fire pit and matches/firelighters are separate.

LPG bottle or butane canisters for the stove/BBQ. The search noted LPG is scarce west of Apollo Bay.
Portable BBQ, Weber Baby Q, hotplate, tongs and BBQ tools. Camping stove and gas bottle are separate.

Painkillers and hangover remedies. Prescription meds, antihistamines etc. are under Medication.

Generic wash-bag contents. Toothbrush, deodorant, lip balm and glasses are separate because people name them specifically.

Adult journalling/sketching; kids' colouring is separate.

Plates, bowls, cutlery, party cups, wine glasses, serviettes, the picnic set. Keep Cup/mugs, stubby holders and bottle opener are separate.
Stubby holder / koozie, any brand or pub.

Any cookware or kitchen appliance: pots, billy, camp oven, kettle, toaster, pie maker, air fryer.
Any knife, multitool, chopping board or scissors.
Washing-up kit: tea towel, detergent, sponge, chux, paper towel, cleaning spray.
Glad wrap, alfoil, zip-lock bags and food containers.
Rubbish bags, bin liners or a car bin; bag for the empties lands here too.
UHF/CB, walkie-talkies, sat phone or PLB. Mobile coverage genuinely drops out through the Otways.
Victorian recreational fishing licence (needed 18-69). Boat licence, dog rego tag and permits lumped here as 'the paperwork'.
Victoria banned single-use plastic bags in 2019, so people do pack their green bags.

hostNotes: Open-ended starter: anything a Victorian would plausibly put in the car for a Great Ocean Road weekend is correct, so grade generously and use the bank mainly to group variants (bathers/togs/swimmers, esky/cooler, Aerogard/bug spray). Specific beats generic: 'snags' and 'food' both land on Snags, but 'chips' is separate from 'snacks'. Beer, wine, goon and cider are separate; a bare 'booze' or any spirit is Booze. 'Tinny' alone is beer, 'the tinny' is the boat (under Kayak). Reject intangibles ('patience', 'a good attitude'), things you buy down there rather than pack (fish and chips, a parma), and places or activities. A sensible item not in the bank is still correct; add it as a new entry.
